title: Projectivization of a rational multiplicative-group representation
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $n\geq0$. Write $N=\{0,\ldots,n\}$ and let $\rho:\mathbf G_{m,F}\to\mathrm{GL}_{N,F}$ be a group-scheme homomorphism [def-sc-group-scheme, def-sc-gm-ga, def-sc-general-linear-group], a rational representation on $F^N$. Let $P=\operatorname{Proj}F[z_i:i\in N]$, the projective space of lines in $F^N$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-sfb-diagonal-projective-action], with total-degree polynomial grading [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. The universal Laurent-valued point of $\mathbf G_m$ gives an invertible matrix $M=(M_{ij})$ over $F[t,t^{-1}]$ via $\rho$. Define the coefficient-fixing graded coordinate substitution $c:F[z_i]\to F[t,t^{-1}][z_i]$ by $c(z_i)=\sum_jM_{ij}z_j$. An algebraic action $a:\mathbf G_m\times_F P\to P$, satisfying the unit and associativity identities, is the projectivization of $\rho$ if, under the canonical comparison $\operatorname{Proj}(F[t,t^{-1}][z_i])\simeq\mathbf G_m\times_F P$, its action morphism equals $\operatorname{Proj}(c)$. The comparison is specified by its projections: the first is the structural morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}F[t,t^{-1}]$ and the second is Proj of coefficient inclusion $F[z_i]\to F[t,t^{-1}][z_i]$. This specifies the line action on every commutative test algebra, not just field-valued points.
